notes: Total 60 with Twi'lek Advisor x2, per the author's note at the top of the strategy ('That should be Twi'lek Advisor x2, not just one'); the list as posted shows one Twi'lek Advisor (59). With it, all section headers match. Endor x2 is as posted (the strategy confirms two Endors).

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (8)': the Objective, Death Star, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Alderaan, Prepared Defenses, Mobilization Points, Oppressive Enforcement and Secret Plans; these count toward the total. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set. The strategy says to start Resistance instead of Secret Plans against EBO, and Battle Order against Ops.
Oppressive Enforcement, Secret Plans, Come Here You Big Coward and Resistance are the Effects (no Defensive Shields in August 2000). Posted 'Dr. Evazon' dested Dr. Evazan.
A later version of this deck is 9828 (Set Your Course For Endor v2 0, 24 August 2000); this post's list differs (Endor x2, Dr. Evazan, Tarkin x2, The Emperor's Shield, Reactor Terminal).
